title: Australia reverses military land sale plans after protests, saving four historic sites
summary_full: The Australian government has opted to retain four significant historical military sites in public hands, responding to widespread public dissent against their potential sale. Notably, Victoria Barracks in Sydney and other sites in Victoria will remain untouched. The government aims to find new public purposes for these locations while preserving their heritage, and part of the broader reforms includes returning certain military lands to Indigenous communities.
